text_block_list.text:
I'll definitely get first place next time,
though!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'll definitely get first place next time,
though!
choice_data_list: Even so, that's an admirable result.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Thanks, but what I want to show people is a lot better than this... I wanna show them peak racing!
choice_data_list: Even so, that's an admirable result.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
That's why I gotta stay focused even if I
place
well and keep trying to do better!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'm counting on you to keep me
on the
right path!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, all right! I'm gonna run my socks
off when
we get back!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing how optimistic Kitasan Black is
warms my
heart.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I've heard older students talk about how
harsh the world of racing is and how easy
it is to get
overtaken if you lose focus
for even a second.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm not going to let my pride get the
best of me.
I'll keep training and aiming
for victory!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Here's to our continued teamwork,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black has a resolute glint in her
eyes as
she gazes steadily toward her
future.
